title: Taiwanese Graduate and Professional Student Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese Graduate and Professional Student Association (TGAPSA), also referred to as UPenn TSA, is a graduate-level Taiwanese student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. It is listed on both the Penn Clubs platform and the PAACH Student Communities directory. The organization explicitly distinguishes itself from the undergraduate Penn Taiwanese Society, noting that it serves “graduate and professional students university-wide.”

TGAPSA holds monthly events and programs designed to foster cultural enrichment and community among its members and the broader Penn community. Documented event types include a Lunar New Year Celebration, film screenings, intercollegiate exchange activities, sports events, workshops, networking socials, and festival parties. The organization also maintains an active relationship with Penn’s Graduate and Professional Student Assembly (GAPSA) as part of its commitment to university-wide unity.
